visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with two men sitting at a restaurant table. The man on the left wears a white t-shirt, while the man on the right wears a cream t-shirt with a red collar. They smile at the camera, raise their glasses filled with beer, and toast. The restaurant background features warm lighting, wooden furniture, and a menu on the table. A red location pin emoji and Japanese/Chinese text appear as overlays. (2) The camera transitions to close-up shots of various dishes being served. A plate of fried pork chop rice (排骨飯) with vegetables is placed on the table, followed by a plate of stir-fried green vegetables (炒青菜). The lighting is bright and focused on the food. The waitress's hands are briefly visible as she serves the dishes. (3) The men continue their meal, showing an oyster omelet (蚵仔煎) and sizzling tofu (鐵板豆腐). The steam from the sizzling plate is clearly visible. The man in the cream t-shirt prepares to eat, bringing his hands together in a 'itadakimasu' gesture. The camera stays close to the table, highlighting the textures of the food. (4) A large skewer of fried intestines (炸肥腸) is introduced. The man in the cream shirt holds the skewer, looking surprised at its size. He takes a large bite, and his facial expression shifts from anticipation to a mix of shock and humor. He appears to be tearing up, wiping his eyes and mouth with a tissue while his companion laughs. (5) The man in the white shirt then tries the same skewer. He takes a bite, chews thoughtfully, and looks at the camera with a puzzled expression. He gestures with his hands, indicating the taste is unexpected or lacking. The video ends with a comedic dialogue where they joke about which cuisine they prefer next time, with the man in the cream shirt leaning his head on the table in mock defeat.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a crisp sound of glasses clinking, followed by the two men saying 'Cheers' in Mandarin ('Ganbei'). A light, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM plays at a moderate tempo. The men's voices are friendly and high-arousal. (2) A soft female voice, the waitress, is heard briefly as plates are served. There's a distinct sound of ceramic plates hitting the wooden table. The men react with excitement, their voices rising in pitch and intensity. (3) The sound of a sizzling plate dominates for a moment, providing a high-frequency white noise texture. One man says 'Itadakimasu' clearly. The sound of utensils clicking against plates and slight chewing sounds are audible. (4) A series of comedic sound effects (boing, ding) are added in post-production as the men react to the large intestine skewer. The man in the cream shirt's voice becomes slightly muffled and shaky as he laughs/cries. (5) The BGM swells slightly as the video concludes. The men engage in a final humorous dialogue. A sudden silence effect is used for comedic emphasis when one man chooses 'Thai food' over 'Taiwanese food'. The audio ends with loud, genuine laughter.
